witness.quote: Whenever any person is riding a bicycle, electric bicycle, or electric scooter upon a sidewalk
witness.reason: The fixed pedestrian can encounter the rider on a sidewalk adjoining the road.
required_context: Capture sound at the pedestrian location with synchronized motion evidence.
Construct a supported sidewalk within the road scene and establish municipal applicability.
Establish covered riding on the sidewalk and a passing sequence for the signal duty.
Establish municipal applicability, sidewalk identity and boundaries, covered device classification and actual riding.
Keep the control pedestrian distinct from the rider and specify both paths.
Preserve unresolved applicability of supplied NRS definitions, the unsupplied NRS 482.029 reference, and undefined yielding, audibility and passing-onset criteria without numerical legal cutoffs.
Retain synchronized trajectories and sound evidence at the pedestrian location; actuation alone does not establish audibility.
Specify separate rider and pedestrian identities, paths and actions, including an overtaking and passing sequence for the signal duty.
witness.subject_reason: This available operator can be the rider; the control pedestrian is the separate recipient of the duties.
